Clay, wheels and good company

Primary tabs

  • View
  • Edit
Submitted by admin on 2 March 2026
Hero image

We are a small, friendly pottery studio in an old mill on the edge of the village. Come and get your hands in the clay — no experience needed.

Every piece we fire is glazed with recipes we mix ourselves, and you can see our gallery of student work before you book.

What you will make

  • A set of mugs thrown on the wheel
  • A hand-built planter
  • Your own glaze test tiles

I came for one evening class and stayed for three years.

— A regular on Thursday nights
Book a class

Opening times

Open Tuesday to Saturday, 10am until 4pm.

Finding us

Park in the mill yard and follow the signs to the back door.
